rationale.complete: Round 1 done: dated card and predictions; two-pass synthetic study at real skeletons with a pre-data amendment; 29-unit replication (regimes II-III) in 11 period folders; natives G51 (Gemini server time, room split) and G44 (separately served leader); a post hoc sign test and congestion world (Amendment 2); confirm.py frozen, guarded and dry-run; estimates rows. Missing: holdout run, exogenous latency instruments, a gate test of coupling on the 4 residual units.
rationale.faithfulness: The field-vs-load question is answered by a sign test the drive model predicts and the data contradict in 28/29 units, with a synthetic congestion world showing the field-share regression is not identified without it. The provider-field rival is rejected (cross-lab equals same-lab), server time validates the proxy. Not higher: the decisive test is post hoc, only 4 units carry a residual, turnaround is a proxy, holdout not run. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E0 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A negative with an operator corollary: platform latency does not make agents co-act, and cross-agent turnaround co-movement is a load meter that grows with N (about 0.2 at N = 30). A methods warning for any field-share regression. No lever.

one_line: The platform's common latency field is real and village-wide but follows activity (load), not drives it; trimmed residual co-activation is significant in 4/29 units.

models.note: Measured latency field does not drive co-activation; sign shows load
Zero-lag field peak held; causal direction reversed

v2.claim: A shared platform latency field exists in #44 and #51 (11/29 units) and grows with N, but it is load, not drive: it rises with the number of active agents (28/29 units) and is not provider-specific; residual co-activation after trimming is significant in only 4/29 units
v2.scope: 29 units; natives G51 (Gemini server time), G44

raters.claim: In regime III the cross-agent call-turnaround (latency) field is a load meter, not a driver of co-activation: it rises with the number of active agents in 28/29 units (median corr +0.11), opposite to the sign a silencing field gives (-0.34 to -0.66), and it is village-wide, not per provider.

ladder.factor: replication of the sign: positive in 28/29 units over 11 periods (beyond 2 null SD in 17/29)
post hoc synthetic identification: W2 drive vs W6 congestion separate only by sign
ground truth: Gemini server time validates the turnaround proxy (r 0.49) and does not co-move across agents
